Who's hunting

The Chokers Gang: one obsession, finding out where Hyderabad actually eats well.

foodhuntboys is a running food diary of Hyderabad — the combos everyone argues about, the biryani spots that spark actual debates, and the food you find in the most unexpected places, like a moving train.

No fancy reviews, no filters on the truth. Just the Chokers Gang, a camera, and a city that never runs out of things worth eating.

🔥 Most viral reel
🥤

Mandi With Coke

The pairing nobody asked for and everybody now swears by. Smoky, spiced mandi rice against an ice-cold coke — this is the reel that blew up and put foodhuntboys on the map.

Our biggest hit
🚄

Food On The Vande Bharat

We took the hunt onto the tracks — what actually shows up on your tray when you order food on the Vande Bharat Express. Verdict included.

Fan favorite
☕

Niloufer → Charminar

The classic old city crawl: Irani chai and Osmania biscuits at Niloufer, then straight into the chaos and flavour of Charminar. A Hyderabad rite of passage.

Old city classic
🍛

Mehfil Biryani, Narayanguda 🫡

A Narayanguda regular that keeps coming up in the DMs. We went in to check if the hype around this handi holds up.

Biryani trail
💕

Gnu Lo Biryani

Straight-up gully-style biryani that doesn't need a fancy setup to bring the flavour. One of the trail's most-requested stops.

Biryani trail
🍢

Absolute Barbecue

The unlimited grill-at-your-table buffet everyone's tried at least once. We went to check if it's actually worth the wait outside.

Buffet spot
🌯

Lebanon Shawarma, Gachibowli

Gachibowli's go-to for a proper shawarma roll — garlic sauce, char-grilled meat, and the kind of wrap that ruins other shawarmas for you.

Gachibowli eats
